issues.description: Early-return branch fires for all non-Tab keys, breaking arrow/Escape/PageUp navigation in the popup.
issues.detail: The guard `not key == Qt.Key_Tab` short-circuits on every non-Tab key, hiding the popup and forwarding the event to textedit. This intercepts Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown/Escape and other keys that previously kept the popup open and navigable. The condition should specifically target Enter/Return, not negate Tab.

issues.description: Re-dispatching event via self.textedit.keyPressEvent(event) bypasses Qt dispatch and risks double-processing.
issues.detail: Calling keyPressEvent directly on the textedit can skip event filters, shortcut handling, and IME composition, and may cause the same key to be processed twice or trigger re-entrancy into completion logic. Safer patterns are event.ignore() or QApplication.sendEvent so Qt routes the event naturally.

issues.description: No CONF_VERSION bump or migration for the new use_enter_for_completions default key.
issues.detail: Adding a key to the completions section in spyder/config/main.py without bumping CONF_VERSION may leave existing users with stale configs missing the key. get_conf is also called without a default, risking KeyError on upgrade. Bump CONF_VERSION and/or pass default=True at the call site.

issues.description: get_conf invoked on every keypress while the popup is visible.
issues.detail: Reading config inside keyPressEvent crosses the plugin config bus on each keystroke during completion. Cache the value when the popup is shown or subscribe to a config-change signal, matching patterns used elsewhere in the editor widget.

issues.description: Use `key != Qt.Key_Tab` instead of `not key == Qt.Key_Tab`.
issues.detail: The double-negation form is non-idiomatic and harder to scan in a hot keypress path. Prefer the standard `!=` comparison. Also consider whether Qt.Key_Backtab (Shift+Tab) should share Tab's accept semantics.

issues.description: No tests added for the new disable-Enter behavior.
issues.detail: The PR changes a user-visible keyboard-handling code path without coverage. A focused test toggling use_enter_for_completions and asserting Enter does not accept while Tab still does would prevent regressions, particularly around the arrow-key navigation issue flagged above.

synthesis.summary: The PR adds a useful opt-in to disable Enter as a completion-accept key, with a default config entry, a preference checkbox, and a guard in the popup's keyPressEvent. The panel's main concern is a logic bug: the `not key == Qt.Key_Tab` guard fires for every non-Tab key, hiding the popup and forwarding events to the editor — which breaks arrow-key navigation, Escape, and other in-popup keys. Secondary concerns are re-dispatching the event directly to textedit (risking double-handling and bypassing Qt dispatch), a missing CONF_VERSION bump / migration for the new default, an uncached get_conf on the keypress hot path, style nits, and no tests for the new behavior.
